checks.detail: Left post 60 + front opening 830 + right post 60 = 950mm; matches drawing header W950
Front post 60 + side panel 330 + rear post 60 = 450mm; matches drawing header D450
Leg clearance 60 + side frame/body 1005 + top panel 35 = 1100mm; matches drawing header H1100
Bottom gap 2 + 4 drawer fronts (4*241=964) + intermediate gaps (2+2+3=7) + top gap 2 = 975mm; frame opening 1005 - bottom rail 30 = 975mm
Frame opening 830 - drawer box width 804 = 26mm total clearance (13mm per side for 42mm ball bearing slide)

doubts: Drawer box material not explicitly identified as Solid Mindy vs Plywood on drawing (assumed Solid Mindy per note 1).
Exact length of anti-warp U-channel not dimensioned explicitly; scaled/derived from 370mm top span.
Handle exact center-to-center hole spacing and length not printed (note specifies according to sample).
